select
from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false inner join shop_info si on sb2c.shop_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false
left join erp_wms.so_b2c_delivery sbd on sbd.source_id = sb2c.id and sb2c.is_deleted = false and sbd.status != 'cancelDelivery' left join erp_sys.dict_partition fdp on fdp.id = sb2cr.partition_id and fdp.is_deleted = false
left join so_b2c_delivery sbd on sbd.source_id = sb2c.id and sb2c.is_deleted = false and sbd.status != 'cancelDelivery' left join foreign_dict_partition fdp on fdp.id = sb2cr.partition_id and fdp.is_deleted = false
where ${params.sqlMap.default} and sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.dict_platform != 'TikTokFully'
${params.permissionSql}
and sb2c.bill_status in( 'waitDistribution','inDistribution','waitShipped','frozen','partialShipped') and sb2c.invalid_status = false and sb2c.pay_status = 'paid'
order by sb2c.id desc

select count(*) from so_b2c sb2c
${params.sqlMap.default} and sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.dict_platform != 'TikTokFully'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM so_b2c_logistics sb2cl WHERE sb2cl.main_id = sb2c.id AND sb2cl.is_deleted = false )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM so_b2c_receiver sb2cr WHERE sb2cr.main_id = sb2c.id AND sb2cr.is_deleted = false )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shop_info si WHERE si.id = sb2c.shop_id AND si.is_deleted = false )
${params.permissionSql}

WITH UniqueWarehouseB2C AS ( SELECT sb2c.id AS main_id FROM so_b2c sb2c JOIN so_b2c_detail sb2cd ON sb2c.id = sb2cd.main_id AND sb2cd.is_deleted = false where sb2c.is_deleted = false GROUP BY sb2c.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sb2cd.warehouse_id) = 1 ) select sb2c.dict_platform as dictPlatform, sb2c.shop_id as shopId, sb2cr.name as buyerName, sb2c.currency as sourceCurrency, sb2cr.receiver_name as receiverName, sb2cr.first_address as firstAddress, sb2cr.second_address as secondAddress, sb2cr.full_address as fullAddress, sb2cd.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sb2cl.logistics_channel_id as logisticsChannelId from so_b2c sb2c JOIN so_b2c_detail sb2cd on sb2c.id = sb2cd.main_id and sb2cd.is_deleted = false JOIN so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false JOIN so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false JOIN shop_info si on sb2c.shop_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false JOIN UniqueWarehouseB2C uwb ON sb2c.id = uwb.main_id
${params.sqlMap.default} and sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.invalid_status = false and sb2c.pay_status = 'paid' and sb2c.bill_status not in('waitShipped','shipped') and sb2c.is_not_merge = false and sb2cl.code = '' and sb2c.label_json !~ ('AFN|U_TAXED|I_TAXED|cainiaoInternationalWarehouse') and sb2c.dict_platform not in ('Shopee', 'mercadolibre','TikTokFully') and not exists (select id from so_b2c_ref where is_deleted = false and (target_id = sb2c.id or source_id = sb2c.id))
${params.permissionSql}
and sb2c.code iLIKE concat('%',#{params.code}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.buyerName}::text,'%')
and sb2cr.receiver_name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.receiverName}::text,'%')
and (sb2cr.first_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%') or sb2cr.second_address ilike concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%') or sb2cr.full_address iLIKE concat('%',#{params.address}::text,'%'))
and sb2c.dict_platform in
#{item}
and sb2c.shop_id in
#{item}
and si.dict_country_code in
#{item}
group by sb2c.dict_platform,sb2c.shop_id,sb2cr.name,sb2c.currency,sb2cr.receiver_name,sb2cr.first_address,sb2cr.second_address,sb2cr.full_address,sb2cd.warehouse_id,sb2cl.logistics_channel_id HAVING count(DISTINCT sb2c.id) > 1 order by sb2c.dict_platform,sb2cr.name,sb2c.shop_id

WITH UniqueWarehouseB2C AS ( SELECT sb2c.id AS main_id FROM so_b2c sb2c JOIN so_b2c_detail sb2cd ON sb2c.id = sb2cd.main_id AND sb2cd.is_deleted = false where sb2c.is_deleted = false GROUP BY sb2c.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sb2cd.warehouse_id) = 1 ) select count(distinct sb2c.id) from so_b2c sb2c JOIN so_b2c_detail sb2cd on sb2c.id = sb2cd.main_id and sb2cd.is_deleted = false JOIN so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false JOIN so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false JOIN shop_info si on sb2c.shop_id = si.id and si.is_deleted = false JOIN UniqueWarehouseB2C uwb ON sb2c.id = uwb.main_id

and (sb2c.label_json not like '%AFN%' or sb2c.label_json not like '%U_TAXED%' or sb2c.label_json not like '%I_TAXED%' or sb2c.label_json not like '%cainiaoInternationalWarehouse%')

and sb2c.dict_platform in
